summary: AMC Entertainment Holdings filed an 8-K disclosing an October 5, 2026 refinancing: a private offering of $2.0 billion 8.875% first lien notes due 2031, an $850 million new first lien term loan, and a $1.120 billion new second lien term loan led by Deutsche Bank Special Situations Group. Proceeds repaid, redeemed, and discharged certain existing indebtedness under Items 1.02 and 8.01. Notes are guaranteed by wholly-owned subsidiary guarantors and secured pari passu with the first lien term facility. The event is a liability-management transaction, not a special situation; watch deleveraging progress and refinancing risk.
